defect_summary: Hub prove printed CI:MET on a dirty worktree, then GitHub ./nlc verify on the commit failed findings-last-pass-fresh because the content-tree hash was stamped before git add of new files.
unsuitable_process: Hub verify is allowed to MET on a tree GitHub will not grade. The stamp hashes git ls-files only. Planit prove-then-commit, release-skill regen checklists, and adopter-centric verify docs do not make prove and CI the same object. The process is too many undocumented steps around a defective gate.
climb_steps: GitHub fitness on c321b42: hub-content-tree-hash b938ecd5… != digest c17252f2…; NLC:NOT_MET.
Local ci_fitness.py had MET before git add of the new RCA files.
content_digest_excluding uses git ls-files; untracked paths do not change the digest; last-pass-fresh can MET while porcelain is dirty.
S14 already named regen-before-prove as skill text; that preventive is still open; Planit prove does not run release Step 1A.
APP-VERIFY and VERIFY-AND-SHIP do not document hash-after-add or porcelain; two hash models exist (ls-files vs worktree_tree_hash).

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
